translation.description: Format a survival response as character labels of equal width.
translation.details: Format a survival response as character labels of equal width.
translation.value: Character labels, padded on the right to the widest label.
translation.example:
from survival import Surv, format_Surv

def one():
    s = Surv([1, 2.5, 10, float("nan")], [1, 0, 1, 1])
    return ["[" + item + "]" for item in format_Surv(s)]

print("\n".join(one()))
